responsibility: Implements the CR16 target backend’s C-side logic that complements the machine description and fills target hooks. This file owns option override handling, register and calling-convention decisions, frame layout computation, prologue/epilogue expansion, address and PIC legalization, operand/address decomposition, attribute handling such as interrupt functions, assembly operand printing, and helper emitters for multiword operations, thereby translating GCC RTL and function state into CR16-specific stack usage, addressing forms, and final instruction sequences.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C implementation for the CR16 port: it defines target-hook functions, frame and calling-convention logic, address/PIC legalization helpers, asm printers, and helper emitters that are invoked by the machine description. Unlike cr16.h it does not declare target macros, unlike cr16.md it is not the RTL pattern table itself, and unlike cr16.opt it does not define user-facing target switches.
